bagPolicy.summary: Only single-compartment bags smaller than 12 × 6 × 12 inches may enter; backpacks are prohibited.
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.summary: Prepaid parking for many events is available at the H&R Block building; check the event page for availability and rates.
parking.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

rideshare.summary: The venue FAQ and parking page do not designate a rideshare pickup point.
rideshare.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

concessions.summary: Bars and box office accept debit or credit cards only. Outside food and beverages may be prohibited depending on the show.
prohibited: Outside food and beverages when prohibited for the show
concessions.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

accessibility.summary: For general admission shows the floor is accessible; reserved seating can include locations on the floor and 400-level balcony. Ask an usher for help at the event.
accessibility.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

reEntry.summary: Guests may leave and re-enter only through the 13th Street doors, with proof of ticket and the appropriate hand stamp or wristband.
reEntry.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

ticketPickup.summary: AXS mobile tickets may be used at entry; hard-print Will Call is available at the box office, opening three hours before showtime, with a $15 per-order delivery fee.
ticketPickup.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

gates.summary: Doors usually open one hour before the time listed for the performance, but the event page has the exact times.
gates.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.
